service_details.title: Car Wash
service_details.subtitle: A cleaner exterior for a brighter drive.
service_details.description: Our exterior car wash service is designed to remove dirt, dust, and road grime, giving your vehicle a fresh and polished look.

service_details.title: Interior Detailing
service_details.subtitle: Breathe new life into your vehicle's cabin.
service_details.description: Our interior detailing goes beyond a simple vacuum. We deeply clean, sanitize, and condition every surface, ensuring a healthier and more luxurious driving environment.

service_details.title: Paint Protection
service_details.subtitle: Preserve your car's flawless finish.
service_details.description: Shield your vehicle's exterior from harsh weather, road debris, and UV rays with our advanced paint protection film and sealants.

process.title: Curing
process.description: Allowing the sealant to bond perfectly.

service_details.title: Engine Cleaning
service_details.subtitle: A clean engine runs cooler and longer.
service_details.description: Grease and dirt buildup can hide leaks and trap heat. Our engine bay detailing safely degreases and dresses your engine compartment for a pristine look.

process.title: Degreasing
process.description: Breaking down heavy oil and grime.

service_details.title: Tyre & Rim Care
service_details.subtitle: Make your wheels the center of attention.
service_details.description: Brake dust and road grime can permanently damage your rims. We meticulously clean and protect your wheels, leaving tyres deep black and rims sparkling.

benefits.title: Sling-Free
benefits.description: No messy tire shine sling on paint.

process.title: Dressing
process.description: Applying tire shine and rim sealant.

service_details.title: Headlight Restoration
service_details.subtitle: Restore clarity and nighttime visibility.
service_details.description: Cloudy, yellowed headlights are a safety hazard and ruin your car's appearance. Our restoration process brings back factory clarity and seals the lens.

benefits.title: Aesthetic Boost
benefits.description: Makes your car look years newer.

process.title: Polishing
process.description: Restoring optical clarity to the lens.

service_details.title: Ceramic Coating
service_details.subtitle: The ultimate armor for your vehicle.
service_details.description: Ceramic coating bonds with your paint at a molecular level, providing years of protection against environmental damage while delivering an unmatched, glass-like gloss.

benefits.title: Self-Cleaning
benefits.description: Dirt and water slide right off.

process.title: Paint Correction
process.description: Flawless polishing of the clear coat.

service_details.title: Scratch Removal
service_details.subtitle: Erase blemishes and restore perfection.
service_details.description: Swirl marks, scuffs, and light scratches dull your car's finish. Our multi-stage compounding and polishing process levels the clear coat for a flawless look.

benefits.title: Restored Color
benefits.description: Brings back the deep, rich paint hue.

process.title: Polishing
process.description: Refining the finish to a high gloss.

process.title: Protection
process.description: Sealing the newly exposed clear coat.

service_details.title: Leather Restoration
service_details.subtitle: Revive the luxury feel of your cabin.
service_details.description: Over time, leather becomes stiff, cracked, and discolored. We deep clean, rehydrate, and protect your leather surfaces to restore their soft, supple feel.

benefits.title: Natural Finish
benefits.description: No greasy or slippery residue left.

process.title: Buffing
process.description: Removing excess for a matte finish.

service_details.title: Glass Treatment
service_details.subtitle: Crystal clear vision in any weather.
service_details.description: Water spots and road film obscure your vision. We polish your glass and apply hydrophobic coatings so rain flies right off your windshield.

benefits.title: Water Repellent
benefits.description: Rain beads up and rolls off.

process.title: Deep Clean
process.description: Removing bugs and heavy road film.

service_details.title: Odor Removal
service_details.subtitle: Breathe fresh, clean air again.
service_details.description: Spills, smoke, and pets leave lingering smells. We don't just mask odors; our ozone treatments and enzymatic cleaners destroy the bacteria causing them.

process.title: Ozone Machine
process.description: Running O3 gas through the AC system.

service_details.title: Express Wash
service_details.subtitle: A spotless car, back on the road fast.
service_details.description: Short on time? Our express wash delivers a thorough exterior clean and a quick interior spruce-up so you can get back to your day looking great.

benefits.title: Spot-Free
benefits.description: Dried properly to prevent water marks.

faqs.subtitle: FAQS
faqs.description: Find quick answers to common questions about our car wash and detailing services.
faqs.left_description: Here are some of the most common questions our customers ask. If you still need help, feel free to contact our team.
faqs.badge_subtitle: Our team is always ready to assist you.

items.question: What is included in a doorstep car wash service?
items.answer: Our doorstep car wash includes exterior washing, wheel and tyre cleaning, window cleaning and a basic interior vacuum (as per selected package). You can also choose additional detailing services if needed.

items.question: How long does the car wash take?
items.answer: It depends on the package selected, but typically ranges from 45 minutes to 2 hours.

items.question: Do you bring your own water and equipment?
items.answer: Yes, our vans are fully equipped with water tanks, generators, and professional detailing equipment.

items.question: Is your service safe for all car types?
items.answer: Absolutely. We use pH-neutral, safe chemicals and microfiber towels to ensure a scratch-free finish for all vehicles.

items.question: Can I schedule a service at my home or office?
items.answer: Yes, we can perform the service anywhere as long as there is enough space to park our van near your vehicle.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept credit/debit cards, UPI, and cash payments after the service is completed.

items.question: Can I reschedule or cancel my booking?
items.answer: Yes, you can reschedule or cancel up to 24 hours before your appointment without any cancellation fees.

items.question: Do you offer any discounts or packages?
items.answer: We have membership plans and seasonal offers. Please check our pricing page or contact our team for details.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: At AutoCare, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or use our services.

sections.title: Information We Collect
sections.content: We may collect personal information such as your name, phone number, email address, location, and service preferences when you:
list: Fill out a contact or booking form
Communicate with us via phone, email, or in person

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
sections.content: We use the information we collect to:
list: Respond to your queries and appointments
Send important updates or service reminders (only if you opt-in)

sections.title: Sharing Your Information
sections.content: We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your information only when required by law or with trusted service providers who help us operate our website and business (such as payment processors or communication tools).

sections.title: Data Security
sections.content: We take reasonable measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, misuse, or disclosure. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.content: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information. If you wish to make any changes or have any concerns about your data, please contact us using the details provided on our Contact Us page.

sections.title: Changes to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with the updated effective date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

sections.title: Acceptance of Terms
sections.content: By accessing and using our website and services, you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, please do not use our services.

sections.title: Service Provision
sections.content: We strive to provide the highest quality car wash and detailing services. However, we reserve the right to refuse service to anyone for any reason at any time.

sections.title: Pricing and Payment
sections.content: All prices are subject to change without prior notice. Payment is due upon completion of the service unless otherwise agreed. We accept cash, credit/debit cards, and UPI payments.
list: Prices may vary based on vehicle size and condition
Additional charges may apply for excessively dirty vehicles
Cancellations must be made at least 2 hours in advance

sections.title: Liability
sections.content: While we take utmost care of your vehicle, we are not liable for pre-existing damage, loose parts, or items left inside the vehicle. Please remove all valuables before our service begins.

sections.title: Refund Eligibility
sections.content: We want you to be completely satisfied with our services. If you are not satisfied, please let us know before the technician leaves your premises. Refunds are considered on a case-by-case basis.

sections.title: Cancellation Policy
sections.content: You can cancel or reschedule your booking free of charge up to 2 hours before the scheduled time. Cancellations made within 2 hours may be subject to a cancellation fee.

sections.title: Processing Refunds
sections.content: If a refund is approved, it will be processed and credited to your original method of payment within 5-7 business days.
